super.name: Super Lyan
super.budget: One cocktail. Selected Super Hours drinks are €6, 17:00–18:00; confirm the offer for your visit.
super.note: Walk-ins for five. Arrive at 17:00 for the early offer and the best chance of sitting together.
super.description: Hotel-bar craft with neon, colour and a much more casual mood. The best-value way into this shortlist if everyone can make an early start.
photos: The neon-lit bar at Super Lyan
A tall cocktail from Super Lyan’s gallery

janine.name: Janine
janine.budget: Estimated food budget; pizzas listed from €16, main dishes around €26–32. Dinner drinks extra.
janine.note: Reserve a table for five in the restaurant, rather than the daytime bakery.
janine.description: Wood-fired pizza, pasta and a warm dining room behind the bakery. Easy to keep affordable with pizza, or make it a longer dinner with shared starters.
photos: Pizza coming out of Janine’s wood-fired oven

oldenhof.name: Bar Oldenhof
oldenhof.budget: Published classics and signatures; premium spirit upgrades cost more.
oldenhof.note: Walk-in only for five. Meet at opening; keep a little flexibility before dinner.
oldenhof.description: Dark wood, intimate seating and carefully made classics: the closest alternative here to the cosy, dressed-up feeling of Fitz’s.
photos: The warm wooden bar at Oldenhof

stacks.name: Stacks Diner
stacks.budget: Estimated food budget for a main and a side or something shared. Dinner drinks extra.
stacks.note: A few reservations each night, plus walk-ins. Try to reserve five before committing to this route.
stacks.description: A proper sit-down evening with American homestyle food and an easygoing atmosphere. This is the requested Stacks Diner, not Stacks Deli.
photos: A window table at Stacks Diner
Fried chicken and a drink at Stacks

dutch.name: Dutch Courage
dutch.budget: Published signature cocktail range; a genever alone is cheaper but is not a cocktail.
dutch.note: Use the bar’s reservation link to check seating for five.
dutch.description: A warm, characterful bar built around Dutch spirits. Less ceremonious than the grand hotel bars, with plenty for curious cocktail drinkers.
photos: A cocktail served at Dutch Courage

tujuh.name: Tujuh Maret
tujuh.budget: Nasi rames €27; Minahasa rijsttafel €39.50 per person, minimum two. Dinner drinks extra.
tujuh.note: Reserve for five; choose à la carte if the group prefers individual mains.
tujuh.description: A welcoming Indonesian restaurant with satay, rendang and plenty to share. Rijsttafel arrives as dishes for the table, rather than a long tasting-menu procession.
photos: A spread of Indonesian dishes at Tujuh Maret

kid.name: KID Amsterdam
kid.budget: Estimated food allowance, not a verified menu quote. Dinner drinks extra.
kid.note: Check a dinner reservation for five through the official website.
kid.description: A neighbourhood dining room centred on nostalgic comfort food, with a relaxed bar and an evening menu. A dinner option just west of the Jordaan.
photos: The bar and dining room at KID Amsterdam
Fried chicken sandwich at KID Amsterdam · photo: Amsterdam NOW
Sandwiches and a noodle dish at KID · photo: Amsterdam NOW

pendergast.name: Pendergast
pendergast.budget: Estimated food budget; published mains €22–33 include a small side, pickles and cornbread. Dinner drinks extra.
pendergast.note: Reserve for five; online bookings accommodate up to six. Some slow-smoked dishes can sell out.
pendergast.description: A small smokehouse near Westerpark serving meats cooked over fruit wood, alongside vegetables and comforting sides. Come for an unhurried, hearty dinner.

nomi.name: Nomi · Vijzelstraat
nomi.budget: Published Friday all-you-can-eat rate for two hours; drinks and any supplements extra.
nomi.note: Reserve a table for five at the Vijzelstraat branch, and confirm the BBQ setup and two-hour sitting.
nomi.description: An interactive dinner with tabletop grilling, sushi and warm dishes ordered in rounds. Best for a lively group that wants variety rather than a quiet, slow tasting menu.
photos: Tabletop grills in Nomi’s Vijzelstraat dining room

esh.name: Esh Pitaria & Bar
esh.budget: Planning allowance for pita and shared dishes; current official prices could not be verified.
esh.note: Call 020 854 3047 to confirm Friday dinner hours, the address and seating for five. The official site was unavailable during research.
esh.description: A casual dinner near the Concertgebouw built around soft pita, hummus and falafel. Editorial listings place it on Moreelsestraat; confirm details directly before choosing this plan.
photos: Esh’s counter and open kitchen · photo: Studio Michiel Wijnen
Hummus, pita and shared dishes at Esh · photo: Raphael Meibergen / De Buik
Fresh pita being prepared at Esh · photo: Raphael Meibergen / De Buik

morgan.name: Morgan & Mees · Amsterdam
morgan.budget: Estimated starter + main or main + dessert. October mains €25–35; larger grill dishes cost more. Dinner drinks extra.
morgan.note: Reserve for five at the Amsterdam restaurant; the separate group enquiry is for ten or more.
morgan.description: A brighter, more polished dinner in a boutique-hotel dining room. The October menu offers fish, meat and a porcini main, with room to spend more on the grill.
photos: The light-filled dining room at Morgan & Mees Amsterdam
A plated meat dish at Morgan & Mees; the current menu may differ

sal.name: Sins of Sal
sal.budget: Published full-size alcoholic cocktail range before optional upgrades.
sal.note: Use the website reservation option or call 020 421 2670 to check a drinks table for five.
sal.description: The liveliest new suggestion: playful agave drinks, savoury twists and a small Jordaan room. A good fit for a group that enjoys a little noise and surprise.
photos: The entrance and evening atmosphere at Sins of Sal
A small plate photographed by Sins of Sal

flying.name: Flying Dutchmen Cocktails
flying.budget: Published range in the currently linked 2026 menu; premium off-menu spirits may cost more.
flying.note: Contact the bar about seating five. Enter Belly of the Beast and take the steep stairs on the right to the first floor.
flying.description: The strongest new choice for classic-cocktail enthusiasts, with a deep spirits selection and a menu built around established recipes. Its Singel location makes Nomi an easy next stop.
photos: Genever Sour photographed by Flying Dutchmen Cocktails
A Gimlet photographed by Flying Dutchmen Cocktails

mokum.name: Bar Mokum
mokum.budget: Most listed cocktails €15; the seasonal Apekop €18. Mocktails from €12.
mokum.note: Reserve for five through the official website; some tables are kept for walk-ins. Find it below MOAK Pancakes in De Pijp.
mokum.description: A snug downstairs bar with table service, Dutch spirits and familiar cocktail families given local twists. The best new cosy alternative when dinner takes you towards Museumplein.
photos: An illuminated genever sign inside Bar Mokum
A short cocktail photographed by Bar Mokum

pairs.label: The easy favourite
pairs.title: Bright drinks. Wood-fired dinner.
pairs.reason: The most effortless plan for five: a playful cocktail bar, a very short stroll, and a restaurant that lets everyone choose their own level of spend. Start early to unlock the €6 drinks.
pairs.tradeoff: The early offer makes the value case. After 18:00, budget €41–62 for a regular cocktail and food. The bar is walk-in, so seating together is not guaranteed.
pairs.drinkCaption: Super Lyan cocktail photo; the exact early-offer serve is not identified.
pairs.pairing: Start with ginger, lime and rum, then go for a tomato-based pizza. A fresh, easygoing flavour progression; choose a new drink with dinner.
pairs.orderNote: Dark ’n Stormy is listed in Super Hours; pizza is listed from €16.

pairs.label: The relaxed one
pairs.title: Dutch spirits. Indonesian spice.
pairs.reason: Keep Dutch Courage for drinks, then head south for a sociable Indonesian dinner with dishes to share.
pairs.tradeoff: This walk exceeds the original 20-minute brief. Allow half an hour between stops, or choose a shorter route from the other plans.
pairs.drinkCaption: Dutch Courage’s cocktail photograph; not confirmed as Koko Klapa.
pairs.dishCaption: Tujuh Maret’s Indonesian spread; the selection can vary.
pairs.pairing: A fruity cocktail before a shared Indonesian dinner. Choose rijsttafel for variety, or individual mains for a smaller meal.
pairs.orderNote: Koko Klapa is listed at €16.50; Minahasa rijsttafel is €39.50 per person.

pairs.label: The cosy one
pairs.title: Low lights. Comfort food.
pairs.reason: The strongest atmosphere match to Fitz’s, with the restaurant you already wanted. An unhurried drink in a beautiful old-school room, then a satisfying, unfussy dinner.
pairs.tradeoff: Stacks is just outside Centrum. The longer stroll still fits the 20-minute brief, but this is less convenient in wet weather. Oldenhof is walk-in for five.
pairs.drinkCaption: Oldenhof’s short-cocktail photo; the exact recipe is not identified.
pairs.dishCaption: Fried chicken at Stacks; presentation and sides may change.
pairs.pairing: A whiskey-led classic sets up the rich, savoury comfort of fried chicken. Order sides for the middle of the table and keep space for something sweet.
pairs.orderNote: Old Fashioned is on the current Oldenhof menu. Stacks lists fried chicken and seasonal sides.

pairs.label: The neighbourhood one
pairs.title: Classic drinks. A comforting dinner.
pairs.reason: Start with a carefully made cocktail at Oldenhof, then walk west for dinner at KID Amsterdam.
pairs.tradeoff: Oldenhof is walk-in for five. Reserve dinner first and allow time for the walk.
pairs.drinkCaption: Oldenhof’s short-cocktail photo; the exact recipe is not identified.
pairs.dishCaption: Fried chicken sandwich at KID · photo: Amsterdam NOW. The current dinner menu may differ.
pairs.pairing: A whiskey-led classic before a relaxed comfort-food dinner.
pairs.orderNote: Choose from KID’s current dinner menu; the food budget is an allowance pending menu confirmation.

pairs.label: The smoky one
pairs.title: Old-school drinks. Slow-smoked dinner.
pairs.reason: Start with a carefully made cocktail at Oldenhof, then walk west for dinner at Pendergast.
pairs.tradeoff: Oldenhof is walk-in for five. Reserve dinner first and allow time for the walk. This route exceeds the original 20-minute brief.
pairs.drinkCaption: Oldenhof’s short-cocktail photo; the exact recipe is not identified.
pairs.dishCaption: The dining room at Pendergast; venue photo, not a picture of the suggested dish.
pairs.pairing: A whiskey-led classic before smoky barbecue and sides for the table.
pairs.orderNote: Brisket is listed at €33, including one small side, pickles and cornbread.

pairs.label: The grill-together one
pairs.title: Classic cocktails. Korean BBQ.
pairs.reason: The strongest new plan for five: a focused cocktail stop, a short walk, and a sociable dinner where everyone can try several dishes.
pairs.tradeoff: Flying Dutchmen’s entrance involves steep stairs. Confirm five seats before booking Nomi’s timed dinner; drinks and supplements are extra.
pairs.drinkCaption: Genever Sour from the official gallery; not the suggested signature cocktail.
pairs.dishCaption: Nomi’s tabletop grills; this is a room photograph.
pairs.pairing: A fresh sour before grilled food keeps the start light. At Nomi, use the rounds to mix grilled dishes with vegetables and lighter sides.
pairs.orderNote: The signature Flying Dutchmen Cocktail is €15 on the current 2026 menu. Nomi Vijzelstraat lists Friday dinner at €41.50 for two hours.

pairs.label: The lively-to-lovely one
pairs.title: Playful drinks. A polished dinner.
pairs.reason: Start with an inventive drink in the Jordaan, then move to Morgan & Mees for a more composed restaurant evening. The two rooms give the night a clear change of pace.
pairs.tradeoff: Sins of Sal is lively and opens at 18:00. Check that a drinks-only table for five works with the bar; reserve dinner separately.
pairs.drinkCaption: Sins of Sal’s entrance and evening atmosphere; not the suggested cocktail.
pairs.dishCaption: A Morgan & Mees food photograph; not confirmed as either suggested dish.
pairs.pairing: A bright agave-based drink before a comforting main. The October dinner menu offers chicken katsu with miso-glazed eggplant, or porcini with polenta.
pairs.orderNote: The Paloma is €15.25. Morgan & Mees lists chicken katsu at €25 and the porcini main at €26; add a starter or dessert as you like.

pairs.label: The pita-and-a-speakeasy one
pairs.title: Downstairs drinks. Pita to share.
pairs.area: De Pijp → Museumkwartier · provisional dinner details
pairs.reason: A cosy cocktail bar followed by an informal pita-and-hummus dinner. This gives the shortlist a new southern route with a lower food allowance.
pairs.tradeoff: Esh’s official site could not be checked. Confirm current Friday kitchen hours, prices, address and seating for five before committing; this plan is provisional.
pairs.drinkCaption: Bar Mokum’s short-cocktail photograph; not the suggested Margarita-style drink.
pairs.dishCaption: Hummus, pita and shared plates at Esh · photo: Raphael Meibergen / De Buik (2024); dishes may change.
pairs.pairing: A tart tequila drink before creamy hummus, warm bread and crisp falafel. Order a few plates for the table and choose individual pita fillings.
pairs.orderNote: The Margarita-style cocktail is listed at €15. Esh’s dish suggestions come from editorial coverage; its current menu and food budget need confirmation.
